s.note: the Italian restaurant Rocky runs, named after Adrian
s.how: Fold 150g salami and slices of provolone onto a big board. Warm 200g olives gently in olive oil and spoon over. Add marinated artichoke hearts, strips of roasted red capsicum and torn Italian bread for mopping up the oil.

s.note: the old boxing gym in Philly
s.how: Blitz 250g pitted medjool dates, 100g rolled oats, 3 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp cocoa and a pinch of salt in a food processor until it clumps. Roll into small balls, coat in desiccated coconut and chill for an hour. Fuel for the next round.

m.how: Freeze a 600g rib eye steak for 30 minutes and shave it paper thin. Fry sliced onion and green capsicum on a hot plate until soft, add the beef and sear fast. Lay provolone over the top to melt, then scoop into split long bread rolls.

w.note: a box from the Italian bakery near Adrian's
w.how: Beat 250g almond meal, 4 eggs, 200g sugar and 200g melted butter. Split in three, tint one green and one red, and bake each in a thin layer at 175C for 12 minutes. Stack with apricot jam between, press overnight, spread with melted chocolate and slice.

d.n: Training camp honey lemon ginger fizz
d.note: between rounds at the training camp
d.how: Grate a 4cm knob of ginger into a small pan with 4 tbsp honey and 100ml water and simmer 3 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 3 lemons into a jug, add the ginger syrup and a small pinch of salt and stir. Fill four tall glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top each with 200ml cold sparkling water. Finish with a lemon wheel.
